summary: Object destructor that installs the off_5ADB90 vtable, frees a 2D slab of child entries via nested loops, then frees two buffer pointers and delegates final cleanup to VtableSetFreeChild. The object's dword index 1071 gates the loop body; index 1072 is the child-row pointer array, indices 1063..1064 bound the outer row loop and 1060..1062 bound the inner column loop (stride 4 dwords / 8 bytes, freeing the second dword of each entry). After the loops it frees index 1070 and index 1072 buffers, stores -1 in a stack marker slot, and returns VtableSetFreeChild(v2).
